statement: A guest program with the published image id ran on a private request whose keccak256 is the call's committed requestHash and committed this responseHash for this callId
assumptions: the on-chain Groth16 verifier bytecode is the published risc0-ethereum v3.0.1 verifier
the committed responseHash is the provider's own receipt commitment, not a value the prover chose
the call's requestHash was read from PayPerCallV8.getCall and is the request the provider committed to
